items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: the girl that looked just like Lena Horne

ctx.x: No, some other girl. And then I had another girl called -- the girl that looked just like Lena Horne. She was with Muhamma (inaudible), pretty girl, and she was doing a location over there in Jersey. We got her costume and she was doing the rumba rhythm stuff. I had another girl who sung ballads, __________. __________ recorded all that.
